ready2_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
In $\odot Z$, $\angle WZX \cong \angle XZY$, $m\angle VZU = 4x$, $m\angle UZY = 2x + 24$, and $\overline{VY}$ and $\overline{WU}$ are diameters.
Find $m\widehat{UY}$.
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In $\odot Z$, $\angle WZX \cong \angle XZY$, $m\angle VZU = 4x$, $m\angle UZY = 2x + 24$, and $\overline{VY}$ and $\overline{WU}$ are diameters. Find $m\widehat{UY}$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a circle with Z as the center, and radii are drawn from Z to points V, U, Y, etc. on the circle. It can be seen that WU is a horizontal diameter passing through the center Z, and VY is a slanted diameter passing through the center Z; point U is on the right side of the circle, and ray ZU is located in the right half-plane between ray ZV and ray ZY. Then reason: Because VY is a diameter, rays ZV and ZY are opposite rays, forming a straight line. Therefore the adjacent central angles ∠VZU and ∠UZY form a straight angle, and their sum is 180°. Given m∠VZU = 4x, m∠UZY = 2x + 24, so 4x + (2x + 24) = 180. Solving gives 6x + 24 = 180, 6x = 156, x = 26. The measure of arc UY is equal to the measure of the corresponding central angle ∠UZY, so m arc UY = 2x + 24 = 2(26) + 24 = 76.

raw_record.question_text:
In $\odot Z$, $\angle WZX \cong \angle XZY$, $m\angle VZU = 4x$, $m\angle UZY = 2x + 24$, and $\overline{VY}$ and $\overline{WU}$ are diameters.
Find $m\widehat{UY}$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at Z with radii drawn to V, U, and Y; the image shows U lies on the right side between V and Y around the circle, and the text says VY is a diameter. Since VY is a diameter, rays ZV and ZY are opposite, so the adjacent central angles ∠VZU and ∠UZY form a straight angle. Use the text labels m∠VZU = 4x and m∠UZY = 2x + 24, set 4x + (2x + 24) = 180, solve x = 26, then use the central-angle/arc rule to get m arc UY = m∠UZY = 2x + 24 = 76.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是以 Z 为圆心的圆，Z 到圆上的 V、U、Y 等点画出了半径。可以看到 WU 是一条水平通过圆心 Z 的直径，VY 是一条斜着通过圆心 Z 的直径；点 U 在圆的右侧，并且射线 ZU 位于射线 ZV 与射线 ZY 之间的右侧半平面中。
再推理：因为 VY 是直径，所以射线 ZV 和 ZY 是相反射线，形成一条直线。因此相邻的中心角 ∠VZU 和 ∠UZY 组成平角，和为 180°。已知 m∠VZU = 4x，m∠UZY = 2x + 24，所以 4x + (2x + 24) = 180。解得 6x + 24 = 180，6x = 156，x = 26。弧 UY 的度数等于对应中心角 ∠UZY 的度数，所以 m弧UY = 2x + 24 = 2(26) + 24 = 76。
